title: Add CONTRIBUTING.md with three core sections
body:
## Summary

The repo accepts external contributions but does not yet have a `CONTRIBUTING.md` explaining how to set up the environment, run the tests, and submit a PR.

## Acceptance criteria

A submitted PR must:

1. Add a new file named `CONTRIBUTING.md` at the repository root.
2. The file must contain three top-level sections (Markdown `##` headings): `Setup`, `Running the tests`, and `Submitting a pull request`.
3. The `Running the tests` section must mention the command `make test`.
4. The PR must come from the same repository (tommycet/proofworks-genlayer).

## Reward

Funded as a ProofWorks bounty case. Worker payout on APPROVE.
